annotations.title: Start a valuation for a specific business

description: Read-only. Use when a user asks what THEIR business is worth. Returns a link to the free ExitValue.ai calculator with the industry, annual revenue and EBITDA pre-filled, so the user only confirms the numbers and answers a few risk questions. It does not return a value itself; use get_valuation_multiples for industry medians.

annual_revenue.description: Annual revenue in US dollars, e.g. 4000000.

ebitda.description: Annual EBITDA in US dollars, e.g. 900000.

industry.description: Sub-vertical id from list_industries (e.g. 'hvac', 'dental-practice'), or a plain-English name ('HVAC', 'dentist', 'plumber', 'MSP'); plain names are mapped to the closest tracked category and the answer says which one was used.

name: start_valuation
